note: Retaken on 3 October 2026 on visible canvases. The baselines taken for #318 and #322 were read while a reading rule hid every Gallery plate (fixed in #331), so those canvases sat at a fallback size. Two runs on main 84c837e agree on 63 of 64 plates and 95 of 95 instruments at DPR 1 and on 64 of 64 plates and 95 of 95 instruments at DPR 2; a third session at DPR 2 drew zebra-beat differently. The two exceptions are listed under unstable and skipped unless PLATE_BASELINE_STRICT=1. The Gallery seeds its desk plate and Plate 01 from the UTC date (gallery-YYYY-MM-DD), so the checker fixes the page clock at "clock".
platform: Playwright 1.58.0 Chromium 145.0.7632.6 headless, Windows 11, ANGLE D3D11, RTX 4090, viewport 1440 x 900
method: tests/plate-baselines.cjs: each plate page scrolled through, 2.5 s settle, SHA-256 of getImageData on every canvas[data-specimen]; instruments drawn alone by renderSpecimen at 320 x 200 CSS px, seed instrument-hash, tick 0.6

unstable.dpr1|gallery|typeface|gallery-typeface: Large glyph rasterisation: 3 to 35 pixels differ by at most 2 levels between browser sessions; within a session the plate redraws identically. Compared by hash only when PLATE_BASELINE_STRICT=1.
unstable.dpr2|instrument|zebra-beat: At least three different hashes on the same commit across browser sessions (two runs of the baseline, one checker run); within a session it repeats exactly. Compared by hash only when PLATE_BASELINE_STRICT=1.
